subject.title: [Bug]: agent --json returns pre-hook assistant text instead of finalized before_message_write output

question: When `before_message_write` rewrites or blocks a CLI assistant message, what should `agent --json` expose to callers?
rationale: The current behavior can leak text that a plugin blocked or rewrote before transcript persistence, but changing blocked-output shape is a public CLI/result contract and security-boundary choice.

options.title: Return finalized or suppressed output
options.body: Use post-hook assistant text for rewrites and return a structured non-leaking blocked/suppressed result when the hook blocks persistence.

options.title: Thread hook output without transcript reread
options.body: Expose the same hook result directly to the JSON builder, but still define the blocked-output contract before implementation.

options.title: Keep transcript-only semantics
options.body: Document `before_message_write` as persistence-only and accept that `agent --json` may expose raw CLI output despite hook rewrites or blocks.

recommendation.title: Return finalized or suppressed output
recommendation.body: Use post-hook assistant text for rewrites and return a structured non-leaking blocked/suppressed result when the hook blocks persistence.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the original hook feature and was explicitly pulled into this issue's timeline for the policy-sensitive follow-up.
